import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

MAXN = 510

def add_value(x, y, p):
    return (x + y) % p

def calc_comb(x, p):
    return (x * (x - 1) // 2) % p

def main():
    data = input().split()
    n, m, p = map(int, data[:3])
    c = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
    f = [0] * (MAXN)
    g = [0] * (MAXN)
    dp = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
    ways = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
    dp2 = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
    ways2 = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
    dp0 = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
    ways0 = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]

    # Initialize binomial coefficients
    for i in range(MAXN):
        c[i][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, MAXN):
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j - 1] + c[i - 1][j]) % p

    f[0] = 0
    g[0] = 1

    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            val1 = c[i - 1][j - 1] * f[j - 1] % p * g[i - j] % p * (i + 1) % p
            val2 = c[i - 1][j - 1] * g[j - 1] % p * f[i - j] % p * (i + 1) % p
            f[i] = add_value(f[i], add_value(val1, val2, p), p)
            temp = c[i - 1][j - 1] * g[j - 1] % p * g[i - j] % p
            sum_comb = (calc_comb(j, p) + calc_comb(i - j + 1, p)) % p
            g[i] = add_value(g[i], temp * sum_comb % p, p)

    # Initialize DP
    for i in range(MAXN):
        for j in range(MAXN):
            dp[i][j] = 0
            ways[i][j] = 0
    dp[0][0] = 0
    ways[0][0] = 1

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(MAXN):
            for k in range(MAXN):
                dp2[j][k] = 0
                ways2[j][k] = 0
        for j in range(min(i, m) + 1):
            for k in range(min(j, m) + 1):
                if k == 0:
                    dp0[i][j] = dp[j][0]
                    ways0[i][j] = ways[j][0]
                # Update dp2 and ways2
                if k <= m:
                    add_value_dp = dp[j][k]
                    add_value_ways = ways[j][k]
                    dp2[j][0] = add_value(dp2[j][0], add_value_dp, p)
                    ways2[j][0] = add_value(ways2[j][0], add_value_ways, p)
                    rem = m - (j - k)
                    if rem >= 0:
                        # ways2[j+1][k+1]
                        val = ways0[i - k][j - k] * c[rem][k + 1] % p * g[k + 1] % p
                        ways2[j + 1][k + 1] = add_value(ways2[j + 1][k + 1], val, p)
                        # dp2[j+1][k+1]
                        val_dp = (dp0[i - k][j - k] * c[rem][k + 1] % p * g[k + 1] % p +
                                  ways0[i - k][j - k] * c[rem][k + 1] % p * f[k + 1] % p)
                        dp2[j + 1][k + 1] = add_value(dp2[j + 1][k + 1], val_dp, p)
        for j in range(MAXN):
            for k in range(MAXN):
                dp[j][k] = dp2[j][k]
                ways[j][k] = ways2[j][k]

    total = 0
    for i in range(m + 1):
        total = add_value(total, dp[m][i], p)
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
